_comment: Three tiers for one entity type. The order is: gather every loadout for minecraft:skeleton, drop the ones whose conditions do not match, pick ONE by pool_weight, then roll caster_chance to decide whether this individual is a caster at all. Both results are persisted on the mob, so neither is re-rolled on reload. Keeping caster_chance identical across the tiers means pool_weight alone controls rarity: 12 + 4 + 1, so the archmage is about 6 percent of casters.
